purpose: set targets for quality, check that teams meet them with evidence, and use the results to improve how work is done
procedure: Define a small set of quality indicators with owners, such as escaped defects, change failure rate, test reliability and customer-reported issues.
Set targets and thresholds per indicator, based on current performance and the business need, and publish the definitions to avoid arguments about numbers.
Check adherence to the definition of done by sampling completed work for tests, reviews, documentation and acceptance, with findings recorded.
Investigate indicators outside thresholds with the team, find causes by examples, and agree an improvement with an owner.
Guard against gaming: review how numbers are produced, and look at several indicators together.
Review results quarterly, adjust targets and retire indicators that no longer drive decisions.
acceptance_criteria: Sampling checks the definition of done on real work
Out-of-threshold results have causes and actions

validation.check: sample ten completed items and check each for tests, review and acceptance evidence
recompute one indicator from raw data

failure_modes.response: Combine indicators and sample real work
Base on baseline and customer impact

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: Escaped defects rise in one team. A sample of ten stories shows four without a test for the error path; the team adds the check to its definition of done, and the indicator is reviewed next quarter.
